newsitem.title: USA: Golden says committee oks Gold Kist offer.
newsitem.headline: Golden says committee oks Gold Kist offer.

text.p: Farm cooperative Gold Kist Inc and Golden Poultry Co Inc said Friday they struck an agreement in principal for Gold Kist to buy the shares of Golden Poultry that it does not already own.
A negotiating committee of independent directors of the board of Golden Poultry and Gold Kist agreed on a price of $14.25 per share, a statement issued by Golden Poultry said.
Gold Kist owns about 10,900,000, or about 75 percent, of Golden Poultry's 14,624,000 shares of common stock outstanding, the statement said.
